# Mediacroma

> Colour grading for short films, music videos and brand films. A colour-grading studio in Braga, Portugal that grades locked edits per finished minute and delivers SDR and HDR masters.

Mailbox: grade@mediacroma.com

## Services and prices (EUR)
- Grade, per finished minute: €90
- Music video grade, up to 4 min: €320
- Look development (3 looks): €250
- Conform, per project: €150
- HDR deliverable add-on: €120
- Remote review session, 1 h: €60

## Does not do
Filming, editing from raw footage, sound mixing, ad placement.
